title: 573. Find Bottom Left Tree Value

examples.explanation: The deepest level holds 1 and 3; the leftmost of the two is 1.
Level by level the tree has [1], [2,3], [4,5,6], [7]; the bottom row's only entry is 7.
A single node is both the top and the bottom-left choice.
